purpose: Non-admission discovery of construction-typology priors, country-level modelled CAT exposure and US electricity generation assets for cross-domain exposure enrichment; all data rights and scientific model-input scopes remain unapproved.

entries.name: UCAD global architectural and construction-material typologies v3
entries.provider: CNRM / Météo-France / CNRS and UCAD collaborators
entries.spatial_scope: Country-level residential architectural archetypes worldwide; generic non-residential typologies
entries.temporal_scope: Zenodo v3 publication 2025-07-23; original surveys and imputed attributes span nonuniform vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Residential typology CSV tables and GeoPackage, global non-residential CSV, survey methodology and imputation/correction evidence; wall, roof, window, HVAC and infiltration attributes
entries.note: Publisher Zenodo record declares CC BY 4.0, but confirm exact asset scope and citation in admission review. Typology-level country distributions and imputed architecture are NOT a verified material field of an individual EUBUCCO/Overture building. Join by country, occupancy, survey/typology class only as an explicitly uncertain prior, preserving source/imputation flags and avoiding false parcel-level certainty.

entries.name: METEOR Level 1 modelled exposure and Oasis OED sample files
entries.spatial_scope: Selected low- and middle-income countries across Africa, Asia, Pacific and Haiti; not comprehensive global exposure coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Original 2020 public exposure publication; individual country input and rebuilding cost vintages differ
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Approximately 15-arcsecond grid (~500 m equator) point cell totals for estimated buildings, area and rebuilding value; separate OED location and placeholder-account CSV files
entries.note: Provider states Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0: do NOT promote this source into a commercial insurance model or redistribute downstream assets without an explicit legal scope decision. Gridded counts/values are estimates rather than insured policy counts or actual addresses. OED Accounts use intentionally default placeholders (e.g. AccNum=1), not actual contracts. Freeze individual country release, cost basis, currency/year, and upstream census/EO assumptions.

entries.name: EIA-860M preliminary monthly electric generator inventory
entries.spatial_scope: United States and Puerto Rico; power plants with combined capacity at least 1 MW
entries.temporal_scope: Monthly preliminary inventory; September 2026 data published 2026-10-23, superseded by later corrections and annual EIA-860
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Plant and generator records including EIA identifiers, generator status/capacity, primary fuel and plant coordinates; published XLS and related EIA API reporting
entries.note: The official EIA-860M is a preliminary generator inventory and can change with revised reporting; exact monthly workbook and record status must be pinned. The EIA FAQ identifies county/state/lat/long in the monthly survey and public API route for operable-generator capacity, but API version and field equivalence to workbook must be tested independently. Generator capacity is not replacement value, business-interruption loss or insurer coverage. Join by stable EIA plant ID and verified coordinates, not name-only fuzzy matching.
